answers.how: Red-first proof with Popen mocked (nothing spawns): each site's flag kwargs equal detached_kwargs(); a planted module that hand-builds flags makes the scan red. pulse.py: kw.update(detached_kwargs()). memory_sync.py is a standalone hook script run by absolute path with no PYTHONPATH, so it adds the repo root to sys.path and imports the helper at call time inside push(); when the import fails it says so on stderr and skips the push (the next SessionStart pull pushes commits that are ahead), never failing the Stop hook.
